name: Holding Christians Accountable
overview: Scripture teaches that Christians are called to live with integrity and responsibility, faithfully keeping their vows and commitments as Numbers 30:2 commands. Accountability within the body of Christ involves lovingly confronting a brother who sins, seeking restoration in meekness as taught in Matthew 18:15 and Galatians 6:1. Each believer will ultimately give an account of themselves to God, with greater responsibility placed on those entrusted with more, as emphasized in Romans 14:12 and Luke 12:48. Furthermore, James 3:1 warns that teachers and leaders will face stricter judgment, underscoring the serious nature of spiritual accountability.
